raw: [Subtitle(text="People pour love into life and long for salvation whether in hope or fear. That's why they choose to pray to gods that they've never seen...", x=300, y=350, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

raw: [Subtitle(text="—That life may never end.", x=300, y=350, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

text: When the final moment comes, when sun, moon and stars fade... when the swaying waves no longer murmur, when all sound and sights are gone.

text: When the colors of winter and spring are no more, and the boundary of night and day blurs—
